metadata.title: BrandLens frozen deterministic review evaluation
metadata.authored: Project author; synthetic and rule-authored fixtures
metadata.note: These 40 fictional drafts are a smoke/benchmark set, not independent validation or user research. Labels represent intended target finding categories for the bundled sample sources and rules. Labels were reviewed by the project author; independent annotator review has not yet been completed.

sources.title: Approved product facts — Dewdrop Serum
sources.content: A 28-day consumer use test with 30 participants found improved skin hydration. The study did not evaluate pigmentation, acne, or effects within three days.

sources.title: Brand voice and claims guide
sources.content: Use clear, warm, evidence-led language. Avoid guarantees, “clinically proven”, “erase”, and unsupported timeframes. Replace “whitening” with “brightening”. Use at most one exclamation mark per post.

sources.title: Historical customer count export
sources.content: An old store export recorded 50,000 customer orders. It is not independently audited and is past its review date; it must not be used as current proof of customer popularity.
